name: How long does a typical multi-family construction project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical multi-family construction project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a multi-family construction project varies significantly based on factors like the project's size, complexity, site conditions, and local permitting processes. A smaller project, such as a duplex or a small apartment building, might take 12-18 months from groundbreaking to completion. Larger developments with multiple buildings or extensive amenities can extend to 24-36 months or more. Opus Builders works to establish realistic timelines during the planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary, typically ranging from 12-18 months for smaller projects to 24-36 months or more for larger developments, depending on complexity and approvals.
